title: Onboard OrionX-9B v1.1: perf profiles, metadata, and automated changelog
author: Maya Chen
description:
Motivation: Add OrionX-9B v1.1 to the model registry with production-ready metadata and performance profiles, and wire up changelog automation so releases are captured in the registry and release notes. This PR contains model metadata, perf benchmark results for typical seq lengths, quantization/variant recommendations, and a small automation hook to append changelog entries to the registry changelog on merge.

What changed (high level):
- Added model metadata file for orionx-9b v1.1 (authors, license, repo, model card pointer, tags).
- Added performance profiles (latency/throughput matrices) for gpu7a and cpu-high instances across common sequence lengths: 64, 128, 512. Included guidance for default batch size and KV-cache heuristics.
- Added quantization recommendations and supported variants (fp16, int8-q4, q2_kv).
- Hooked changelog automation (scripts/changelog/append_release.py) and CI job that generates the registry release note snippet; the CI artifact is uploaded and the changelog bot appends on merge.
- Small validation tests for metadata schema and perf profile shape.

Checklist:
- [x] Model metadata conforms to registry schema
- [x] Performance profiles validated against perf harness (benchmarks attached)
- [x] Changelog automation added and covered by unit tests
- [x] Docs updated (model index + release notes template)

Testing and verification:
- Ran perf-harness/orionx-9b-v1.1 on internal perf-canary infra for seq lengths 64/128/512; numbers included as artifacts. No regressions vs v1.0 for latency at target batch sizes; throughput improved ~7% on gpu7a for fp16.
- Metadata validated via registry schema validator (tests/registry/test_metadata_validator.py).
- CI job: registry/changelog: generates a markdown snippet based on PR metadata and created release tag.

Rollout plan:
- Merge to main (this PR) -> changelog snippet produced and appended -> model becomes queryable in the catalog UI behind a feature flag for 48h -> monitor latency/cost metrics and quality evals.

Notes and gotchas:
- The changelog automation is additive and idempotent (script guards on duplicate entries).
- A follow-up PR will add a migration step to populate older releases into the structured changelog.
